settings.name: OIDF_SSF_LOGOUT_ALLOW_SUB_PARAM
settings.description: Whether the logout filter takes the subject from an unverified sub parameter when no token verifies, for a development rig; any caller can then aim a session-revoked signal at any subject

when_wrong.detail: Anything but true or false (in any case): an ERROR at each logout naming the setting, and the sub parameter is not taken. The development profile reads a legacy spelling (yes, no, 1, 0, on, off) as false, with a warning naming the strict spelling
